en: Then that slayer of hostile hero, namely Abhimanyu, versed in all the modes, of warfare, beholding the swiftly advancing sword, evaded its strike by the agility of his movements.

sa: तन्मे दहति गात्राणि शुष्कवृक्षमिवानलः। यदिच्छामि महाभाग त्वत्प्रसादात् परंतप॥
en: This it is that is corroding my limbs like fire burning a withered tree. Therefore, O you of eminent parts, O slayer of foes, through your grace, I wish,

sa: सा गदा वेगवन्मुक्ता प्रायाद् द्रोणजिघांसया। तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम भारद्वाजस्य विक्रमम्॥
en: Having been thus hurled by his hand, that fearful mace flew through the sky for the destruction of Drona. Then again we saw the wonderful prowess of Bharadvaja's son.

sa: स्वानप्याददते स्वाश्च शूराः परमदुर्जयाः। विमर्दः सुमहानासीदल्पानां बहुभिः सह॥
en: Those brave warriors who were incapable of being easily defeated, cut down even their own friends. Fierce was the struggle that took place between the few and the many.

sa: द्रोणादनन्तरं यत्तो भगदत्तः प्रतापवान्। मगधैश्च कलिङ्गैश्च पिशाचैश्च विशाम्पते।॥
en: After Drona marched Bhagadatta endued with great prowess and determined to fight to the last), being supported by the Magadhas, the Kalingas, and the Pisachas, O ruler of men.

sa: पदातिरेकः संक्रुद्धः शत्रूणां भयवर्धनः॥ सम्मोहयामास स तान् कालान्तकयमोपमः।
en: Thus fighting on foot in great rage like Yama himself at the universal dissolution, he struck terror into the hearts of his enemies. Those brave warriors all became confounded.

sa: एवमुक्तः स वार्ष्णेयः कौन्तेयनामितौजसा। रथं श्वेतहयैर्युक्तं प्रेषयामास संयुगे॥
en: Thus spoken to by Kunti's son of immeasurable prowess, he of the Vrishni race drove in the thick of the battle that car to which were yoked white steeds.

sa: क्रुद्धं तु पाण्डवं दृष्ट्वा देवगन्धर्वराक्षसाः। प्रविव्यथुमहाराज व्याकुलं चाप्यभूज्जगत्॥
en: Beholding the son of Pandu blaze forth in rage, the celestial, the Gandharvas, and the Rakshasas became afflicted O monarch, and the whole world was seized upon by anxiety.

sa: एष भीष्मः शान्तनवो योद्धुकामो धनंजयम्। सर्वात्मना कुरुश्रेष्ठस्त्यक्त्वा जीवितमात्मनः॥
en: This Bhishma, this son of Shantanu, this foremost of the Kurus, has resolved to fight with Dhananjaya, heedless of his very life and to the best of his abilities,

sa: तुण्डमासीन्महाराज भीमसेनो महाबलः। सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः॥ सात्यकिधर्मराजश्च व्यूहग्रीवां समास्थिताः। पृष्ठमासीन्महाराज विराटो वाहिनीपतिः॥
en: Bhimasena endued with great strength, O king, formed its beak. The son of Subhadra, the sons of Draupadi, the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha. Satyaki and the very virtuous king Yudhishthira were stationed on the neck of that array. Virata, the leader of a division, O monarch, formed its back.

sa: विचकर्ष ततो दो• धनुर्जलदनि:स्वनम्। अथास्य तदपि क्रुद्धश्चिच्छेद धनुरर्जुनः॥
en: He drew that bow, the twang of which resembled the roar of the clouds, with his two hands. But Arjuna, now excited with anger, again cut down that bow.

sa: तं प्रत्यविध्यद् दशभिर्भीष्मः शान्तनवः शरैः। रुक्मपुजैर्महेष्वासः कृतहस्तो महाबलः॥
en: Thereat Bhishma the son of Shantanu, that mighty bow-man endued with great strength and lightness of hands, pierced him in return with ten shafts furnished with wings of gold.

sa: वपुर्भिश्च नरेन्द्राणां चन्द्रसूर्यसमप्रभैः। विरराज तदा राजंस्तत्र तत्र रणाङ्गणम्॥
en: Then, O monarch, here and there, the field of battle appeared beautiful being strewn over with the bodies of monarchs which were effulgent like the sun or the moon.

sa: एवं प्रव्रजिताश्वानि भ्रान्तनागरथानि च। सैन्यानि समसज्जन्त प्रयुद्धानि समन्ततः॥ निरभ्रे विद्युतस्तीवा दिशश्च रजसाऽऽवृताः। प्रादुरासन् महोल्काश्च सनिर्घाता विशाम्पते।॥
en: Thus, running steeds and wheeling and whirling cars and elephants, in that battle, engaged with one another, all over the field. Flashes of lightning illumined the welkin although there was no cloud, and the points of the compass were shrouded in thick clouds of dust; and O ruler of men, large meteors were scen falling with terrible sounds.

sa: उत्पत्य निपतन्त्यन्ये शरघातप्रपीडिताः। तावकानां परेषां च योधा भरतसत्तम॥
en: Many warriors of your army and many belonging to the host of enemy afflicted with shafts-wounds, running hither and thither (with pain), (at last) jumped up and fell down.

sa: अदोमूला सुराणां श्रीयंत्र शक्रोऽभ्यषिच्यत। सुरराज्येन विप्रर्षे देवैश्चात्र तपश्चितम्॥
en: Here is the source of the prosperity of the gods, where Shakra was appointed in the kingship of the immortals, where even the gods, O regenerate Rishi, practiced asceticism.

sa: ध्वजं सिंहं स्थात् तस्मादपनीय महारथिः। प्रणिधाय शमीमूले प्रायादुत्तरसारथः॥
en: Having taken down the banner with the lion's figure and placed it at the foot of the Shami tree the mighty car-warrior set out with Uttara as his charioteer,

sa: मानाग्निहोत्रमुत मानमौनं मानेनाधीतमुत मानयज्ञः। एतानि चत्वार्यभयंकराणि भयं प्रयच्छन्त्ययथाकृतानि।।
en: An Agnihotra ceremony performed out of vanity, silence, study out of vanity and pride based upon haughtiness, these four though not fearful of themselves, become fearful when performed unduly.

sa: शराणां पुखसक्तानां मौर्व्याभिहतया दृढम्। श्रूयतां तलयोः शब्दो भेर्योराहतयोरिव॥
en: Struck firm by these winged shafts the bow string will cause these gloves to produce a sound that will be heard to resemble that of a couple of kettle-drums.

sa: श्रुतं ते पुरुषव्याघ्र कुन्त्याः कृष्णस्य संनिधौ। वाक्यामर्थवदत्युग्रमुक्तं धर्म्यमनुत्तमम्॥
en: It has been heard by you, O foremost of men, what inciting words Kunti has said to Krishna, than which nothing is more excellent and which lead to virtue.

sa: युधिष्ठिरेण सहित उपाविशदरिंदमः। ततस्तेषुपविष्टेषु पार्थिवेषु समन्ततः। वासुदेवमभिप्रेक्ष्य रौहिणेयोऽभ्यभाषतः॥
en: That chastiser of foes then sat down with Yudhishthira and the son of Rohini then said, with his eyes on Vasudeva, to those rulers of the earth seated together.

sa: अपश्यमेनं श्रीमन्तं मत्स्यं भ्राजिष्णुमुत्तमम्। विराटमुपतिष्ठन्तं दर्शयन्तं च वाजिनः॥
en: I now see that graceful one wait upon the richly dressed and excellent Virata, the king of the Matsya's and make a show of his horses before the king.

sa: त्वमिमं पुण्डरीकाक्षमप्रधृष्यं दुरासदम्। पापैः सहायैः संहत्य निग्रहीतुं किलेच्छसि॥
en: This one with lotus eyes, who can not be vanquished, in fact who is hard to stand save against, you want to capture, being united with your wicked supporters.

sa: अर्धचन्दैश्च चन्द्रश्च मत्स्यैः समृगपक्षिभिः। पुष्पैश्च विविधैश्चित्रं मणिरत्नैश्च सर्वशः॥
en: (And it was ornamented) with figures of half moons and of fishes, animals and birds with various kinds of flowers and with all sorts of precious stones all over.

sa: मद्वाक्यमेतद् राजेन्द्र यद्येवं न करिष्यसि। स्थास्यामीह भवत्पादौ शुश्रूषन्नरिमर्दन॥
en: O king of kings, O chastiser of foes, if you do not act as I say, I shall then stay here and serve at your feet with all respect.

sa: नगराणीव गुप्तानि दुराधर्षाणि शत्रुभिः। आसन् रथसहस्राणि हेममालीनि सर्वशः॥
en: Each was protected as a city should be and was therefore hard to be captured by the enemies; thousands of those decked with gold were posted in all directions.

sa: अविधेयानि हीमानि व्यापादयितुमप्यलम्। अविधेया इवादान्ता हयाः पथि कुसारथिम्॥
en: These, when not kept under proper control, are sufficiently powerful to kill a man like untrained horses not properly managed which can kill an incompetent driver on the road.

sa: न चेद् भागं कुरवोऽन्यत्र युद्धात् प्रयच्छेरंस्तुभ्यमजातशत्रो। भैक्षचर्यामन्धकवृष्णिराज्ये श्रेयो मन्ये न तु युद्धेन राज्यम्॥
en: If the sons of Kuru do not give back to you your share without war, O you who have created no enemies; but I consider that living as a beggar in the kingdoms of Andhaka and Vrishni is better than a kingdom (attained) by means of war.

sa: नेत्राभ्यां नस्ततश्चैव श्रोत्राभ्यां चसमन्ततः। प्रादुरासन् महारौद्राः सधूमाः पावकार्चिषः॥
en: From his two eyes and from his two ears and his nose issued forth continually the great Rudra himself in the shape of sparks of fires accompanied with smoke.

sa: आसनेभ्यो महार्हेभ्य उदतिष्ठन्नमर्षिताः। बाहून् परिघसंकाशान् संस्पृशन्तः शनैः शनैः॥
en: Being excited with wrath (towards the Pandavas) they rose up from their seats of great value and began slowly to rub their arms which had the circumference, of maces.

sa: एवमुक्ताः पाण्डवेन कौन्तेयेन यशस्विना। प्रत्यब्रुवन् मृगास्तत्र हतशेषा युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Having been thus addressed by the son of Kunti, the illustrious Pandava (Yudhishthira), those deer, the remaining ones of the herd that had been slaughtered, thus spoke to him,

sa: हास्यवस्तुषु चान्यस्य वर्तमानेषु केषुचित्। नातिगाढं प्रहृष्येत न चाप्युन्मत्तवद्धसेत्॥
en: In the presence of the king if any laughable matter is mooted, a person should not enjoy it with the utmost reserve, nor should he laugh like a maniac.

sa: यस्य कोपो महाबाधः प्रसादश्च महाफलः। कस्तस्य मनसापीच्छेदनर्थं प्राज्ञसम्मतः॥
en: What person, that is agreeable to the wise, can even contemplate a wrong to him, whose wrath is a great trouble and whose propitiation is productive of great fruits?

sa: एवं द्वितीये सम्प्राप्ते यथाकाले मनीषिणाः। आगम्य बुभुजे सर्वमन्नमुच्छोपजीविनः॥
en: In this manner during the next sea-son, he came again and ate up all the food given to him by that wise Rishi leading the Unccha mode of life.

sa: येनाहं कुन्तिभोजाय धनं वृत्तैरिवार्पिता। बालां मामार्यकस्तुभ्यं क्रीडन्ती कन्दुहस्तिकाम्॥
en: By him I was given away to Kuntibhoja like wealth given away by a rich man. While yet a girl playing with a ball in my hand, your grand-father.

sa: अस्मिश्चेदागते काले मिथ्या चातिक्रमिष्यति। लोकसम्भाविता: सन्तः सुनृशंसं करिष्यथ॥
en: You will be doing what is cruel and mean, though you are respected by the world; and if you are ever contemptible, I shall abandon and disown you forever.

sa: तत्र कार्यमहं मन्ये कालप्राप्तमरिंदमाः। क्रियमाणे भवेच्छ्रेयस्तत् सर्वं शृणुतानघाः॥
en: O chastiser of foes, I therefore consider that the time has come for you to act; O sinless men, listen to that by doing which you will obtain benefit.

sa: देवमानुषयोः शक्त्या तेजसा चैव पाण्डवान्। कुरून् शक्त्याल्पतरया दुर्योधनमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: And having concluded that the Pandavas had strength and prowess, both human and divine on, their side and that the Kurus were weaker in strength, he said to Duryodhana!

sa: दुर्योधनो भीमसेनमभ्यगच्छन्मनस्विनम्। पश्यतां कुरुमुख्यानां तस्य द्रक्ष्यति यत् फलम्॥
en: In the presence of the chiefs among the Kurus he will see what the consequences of that will be. Vrikodara having once been made an enemy cannot make peace.

sa: राजधर्मानवेक्षस्व पितृपैतामहोचितान्। नैतद् राजर्षिवृत्तं हि यत्र त्वं स्थातुमिच्छसि॥
en: Duly following the examples of your father and grandfather, observe the duty or a king-this is not the life of a royal Rishi in which you desire to live.

sa: गतास्तु दक्षिणामाशां ये वै वानरपुङ्गवाः। आशावांस्तेषु काकुत्स्थः प्राणानार्तोऽभ्यधारयत्॥
en: And though sorely grieved (at this unpleasant news) the descendant of Kakustha dragged his existence hopeful of the success of those great monkeys who were despatched towards the south.

sa: त्रिविष्टपं प्रपद्यस्व पाहि लोकाञ्छचीपते। जितेन्द्रियो जितामित्रः स्तयूमानो महर्षिभिः॥
en: O you lord of Sachi, go you to heaven and rule over the world, after conquering your senses and subduing your enemies and being propitiated by the great Rishis.

sa: अनुपासितवृद्धत्वाच्छ्रियो दर्पाच्च मोहितः। वयोदर्पादमर्षाच्च न ते श्रोय ग्रहीष्यति॥
en: Owing to their never having respected the aged and to vanity and folly incident to their age and to wrath they will not accept what is। for their good.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ददानीत्येव भगवानुत्तरं प्रत्यपद्यत। भूयश्चाश्वासयामास कौन्तेयं सत्यविक्रमम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : That god then replied “I give you (this boon also)” He then consoled the son of Kunti endued with the strength of truth (in these words),

sa: दासकर्मकरान् भृत्यानाचार्यविक्पुरोहितान्। अवृत्त्याऽस्मान् प्रजहतो दृष्ट्वा किं जीवितेन ते॥
en: Seeing our servants who used to attend on us doing mineral offices, our preceptors, and our priests go away leaving us, what is the good of life to you?

sa: यावन्न दृश्यते पार्थः स्वेऽप्यनीके व्यवस्थितः। भीमसेनो महेष्वासस्तावच्छाम्यतु वैशसम्॥
en: So long as the son of Pritha, the great bowman Bhimasena is not seen to take up his position in the division of his own army, let hostilities cease,

sa: प्रवर्षतः शरवातानर्जुनस्य शितान् बहून्। अप्यर्णवा विशुष्येयुः किं पुनर्मांसयोनयः॥
en: At the shower, by Arjuna, of a great many sharp edged arrows, even the oceans dry up, not to speak of those things, that owe their origin to flesh.

sa: भजस्व मां वरारोहे महार्हाभरणाम्बरा। भव मे सर्वनारीणामुत्तमा वरवर्णिनी॥
en: O excellent lady, live under my protection and O fair, complexioned damsel, adorned with rich ornaments and dresses be the first lady among all the females (of my harem).

sa: परुषाण्युच्यमानांश्च पुरा पार्थानुपेक्षसे। कृत्स्नं राज्यं जयन्तीति प्रपातं नानुपश्यसि॥
en: Formerly you neglected the Parthas, who were being addressed in hashed words thinking that the kingdom had been acquired (by your sons). You did not then foresee this fall.

sa: एको दोषोऽस्ति नान्योऽस्य सोऽद्यप्रभृति सत्यवान्। संवत्सरेण क्षीणायुहन्यासं करिष्यति॥
en: He has only one defect and no other. Satyavana who has a little of life in store for him, will, within a year from this day, breathe his last.

sa: एवं मनुष्यमप्येकं गुणैरपि समन्वितम्। शक्यं द्विषन्तो मन्यन्ते वायुर्दुममिवैकजम्॥
en: In the same way people consider a man, who is alone though endowed with many virtues, capable of being vanquished, like a tree standing alone by the wind. are

sa: विदुर उवाच नान्यत्र विद्यातपसोर्नान्यत्रेन्द्रियनिग्रहात्। नान्यत्र लोभसंत्यागाच्छान्तिं पश्यामि तेऽनघ।५।।
en: Vidura said In nothing but knowledge and devotion, in nothing but the control of senses, in nothing else but the perfect abandonment of avarice, do I see your good.

sa: येन राजा महावीर्यः प्रविश्यान्तःपुरं पुरा। वासुदेवसहायेन जरासंधो निपातितः॥
en: (That Bhimasena) by whom, aided by the son of Vasudeva, the king Jarasandha of great prowess was killed after his inner apartments being entered in the days of old.

sa: दिष्ट्या भवद्भिर्बलिभिः शक्तैः सर्वैर्न हिंसितः। दुर्वृत्तो धार्तराष्ट्रोऽयं सामात्यज्ञातिबान्धवः॥
en: (He said), “It is fortunate for us that though you possess great prowess, you did not kill the wicked sons of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana) with all his counsellors and relatives.

sa: आवर्तय कुरूढिात्वा पशून् पशुमतां वर। निर्दहैषामनीकानि भीमेन शरतेजसा॥
en: O you the foremost of those who own cattle, having discomfited the Kurus, do you bring back the animals, consume their soldiers with the dreadful prowess of your shafts,

sa: महावेगो महोत्साहो महाबाहुर्महाबलः। मन्दानां मम पुत्राणां युद्धेनान्तं करिष्यति॥
en: Possessed of great force and of great energy, possessed of long arms and of great strength will put an end to the existence of any wicked sons in battle.

sa: ब्राह्मणानां परिभवात् परिवादाच्च भारत। कुलान्यकुलतां यान्ति न्यासापहरणेन च॥
en: By speaking ill of the Brahmanas and by insulting them, O Bharata, the high families as become degenerated, also by the misappropriation of what has been entrusted to them..

sa: वासुदेवार्जुनौ वीरौ समवेतौ महारथौ। नरनारायणौ देवौ पूर्वदेवाविति श्रुतिः॥
en: The son of Vamdeva and Arjuna, the two great heroic car-warriors that have now allied together are the two ancient gods, Nara and Narayana. Such is the general belief.

sa: सभायां क्लेशितैवीरैः सहभायैस्तथा भृशम्। अरण्येविविधा: क्लेशाः सम्प्राप्तास्तैः सुदारुणाः।।१०
en: In the court too serious troubles were experienced by the heroes along with their wife and in the forest diverse troubles of great magnitude were met with by them.

sa: अकरोन्मयि यत् पापं भवती सुमहात्ययम्। अपाकीर्णोऽस्मि यन्मातस्तद् यशःकीर्तिनाशनम्॥
en: The behaviour that you adopted towards me was a greatly sinful one, and (owing to that) I have sustained what is tantamount to the destruction of fame and renown.

sa: पञ्चेन्द्रियस्य मर्त्यस्यच्छिद्रं चेदेकमिन्द्रियम्। ततोऽस्य स्रवति प्रज्ञा दृतेः पात्रादिवोदकम्॥
en: Of the five senses in this world, if one has a hole, them from that hole gets out the wisdom of an intelligent man like water, from a pot.

sa: राजानो राजपुत्राश्च दुर्योधनवशानुगाः। रणे शस्त्राग्निना दग्धाः प्राप्स्यन्ति यमसादनम्॥
en: The kings and princes, following the leadership of Duryodhana, consumed by the fire of weapons in the battle, will go to the abode of Yama, the king of death.

sa: पक्षतुण्डप्रहारैश्च शतशो जर्जरीकृतम्। चक्षार रुधिरं भूरि गिरिः प्रस्रवणैरिव॥
en: By striking him with wings and beak several times, he (frightfully) lacerated (Ravana). And blood began to gush (out of his body) as copiously as waters from a mountain-spring.

sa: कदर्थीकृत्य तद् वाक्यमृषेः कण्वस्य दुर्मतिः। ऊरूं गजकराकारं ताडयन्निदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Without regarding those words of the Rishi Kanva, the one, of evil intellect, said these words slapping his thighs which were of the size of those of an elephant.

sa: तमेनं मायिनं क्षुद्रमन्तर्हितरथं बलात्। राक्षसं निहनिष्यन्ति दृष्ट्वा वानरयूथपाः॥
en: He is hidden from the public gaze so we must slay him, had he been fighting openly the leaders of the monkey hosts could have slain that Räks asas.

sa: न चान्यो राक्षसान्हन्ता सुरारीन्देवकण्टकान्। ऋते नारायणं देवं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम्॥
en: No other than the god Nārāyaṇa, holding the conch, the discus and the mace, could slay those Råkşasa-foes to the celestials and thorns in the side of the deties.

sa: त्वत्कृते तमनिद्रा च शोकश्चिन्ता च राघवम्। तापयन्ति महात्मानमग्न्यगारमिवाग्नयः॥
en: For you, sleeplessness, grief and anxiety are distressing Rāghava like to three fires, (The aggregate of the three fires maintained by the Brāhmaṇa house-holder) burning down the fire temple.

sa: निशाचराणामधिपो महाबलः। तदेव पुत्रव्यसनं विचिन्तयन् मुहुर्मुहुश्चैव तदा विनिःश्वसन्॥
en: With the fire of his rage blazing up, th exceedingly powerful sovereign of the nigh rangers, absorbed with the danger that ha befallen his son, began to sigh momentarily.

sa: सालं चतुर्भिश्चिच्छेद वानरं पञ्चभिर्भुजे। उरस्येकेन बाणेन दशभिस्तु स्तनान्तरे॥
en: He severed the Sāla by means of four shafts, and wounded the monkey in the arm with five, in the chest, with one, and with ten, between the teast.

sa: छिन्नमात्रं च तच्छीषं पुनरेव प्रदृश्यते॥ तदप्यशनिसंकाशैश्छिन्नं रामस्य सायकैः।
en: As soon as the second head was chopped off in the encounter by means of shafts another appeared again. And that was again severed by Rāma's shafts resembling thunder-bolts.

sa: भूताश्चार्था विरुद्ध्यन्ति देशकालविरोधिताः। विक्लवं दूतमासाद्य तमः सूर्योदये यथा॥
en: Works, almost accomplished, when entrusted to an inconsiderate emissary, are generally spoiled, out of season and out of place, like to darkness driven by the appearance of the sun.

sa: हतैर्वानरमुख्यैश्च शक्तिशूलपरश्वधैः। निहतैः पर्वताकारै राक्षसैः कारूपिभिः॥ शस्त्रपुष्पोपहारा च तवासीधुद्धमेदिनी। दुर्जेया दुर्निवेशा च शोणितास्रावकर्दमा॥
en: And, with able monkeys slain; and darts and javelins and axes; and slaughtered Raksasa wearing forms at pleasure, lying mountain likethe field of battle, seeming to have offerings of arms representing flowers, became difficult to recognise, and inaccessible; and the earth was drenched with streams of blood.

sa: अहं दाशरथेनोढा मोहात्स्वकुलपांसनी। आर्यपुत्रस्य रामस्य भार्या मृत्युरजायत ॥
en: I, the befouler of my line, who had been wedded by Dasaratha's son through want of discretion, becoming the wife of the revered Rāma, was (in reality) his Death.

sa: एवं नानाप्रहरणैर्यमेनामित्रकर्षिणा। सप्तरात्रं कृतः संख्ये विसंज्ञो विमुखो रिपुः॥
en: And in this way that destroyer of foes Yama fought for seven nights with various arms; until at length his enemy was driven back and deprived of his senses.

sa: पराक्रमोत्साहमनस्विनां च सुरासुराणामपि दुर्जयेन। त्वयाप्रमेयेण सुरेन्द्रसंघा जिताश्च युद्धेष्वसकृन्नरेन्द्राः॥
en: Invincible to the gods and Asuras themselves gifted with prowess, high spirits and intelligence, you had in battle oftentimes put to the rout the chiefs of celestials and monarchs.

sa: प्रभग्ने राक्षसबले नारायणशराहते। सुमाली शरवर्षेण निववार रणे हरिम्॥
en: On the Rākşasa army having been broken in consequence of the beating it got at the hands of Nārāyaṇa, Sumāli with showers of shafts resisted Hari in the encounter.

sa: ननाद च तदा तत्र वसुधा शल्यपीडिता। तस्माद्ब्रणमुखात्तोयमुत्पपात रसातलात्॥
en: And hurt with the dart, the Earth emitted roars; and in consequence of this, water began to gush out at the mouth of the wound from the subterranean regions.

sa: सोऽपि सैन्यानि संक्रुद्धो वानराणां महौजसाम्। ममन्थ परमायत्तो वनान्यग्निरिवोत्थितः॥
en: Incapable of containing himself (through rage), Kumbhakarņa on his part fell to agitating the ranks of the powerful monkeys, even as a fire breaking out burn dowit a forest.

sa: मां दृष्ट्वा नागनासोरु गूहमाना स्तनोदरम्। अदर्शनमिवात्मानं भयान्नेतुं त्वमिच्छसि॥
en: O you having thighs like the trunks of elephants, while you had, beholding me, hidden your breast and belly, perhaps you are afraid of exposing your person to me.

sa: शयानः शत्रुनाशार्थं भवान्संबोधितो मया। अयं हि कालः सुमहान्राक्षसानामरिंदम॥
en: I have waked you up that wast lying down, in order that you mightst destroy the enemy. O subduer of foes, perilous is the time for the Rāks asas.

sa: अदृष्टं मृत्युमापन्नः कस्मात्त्वं नयशास्त्रवित्। व्यसनानामुपायज्ञः कुशलो ह्यसि वर्जने॥
en: And why, versed in polity as you wast, did you come by death, unforeseen? You were acquainted with the means of warding off misfortune, and skilled in doing so.

sa: ततः स मथिताष्टाश्वं रथं भग्नाक्षकूबरम्। विहाय न्यपतद्भूमौ दुर्धरस्त्यक्तजीवितः॥
en: Thereat his eight steeds getting mangled, and the wheels and pole of his car having been broken, Durdhara leaving the car, fell down to the earth, deprived of life.

sa: अथवा मोचयिष्यामि त्वामद्यैव सराक्षसात्। अस्माद् दुःखादुपारोह मम पृष्ठमनिन्दिते॥
en: Or I shall release you even to-day from the grasp of that Räkşasa and these miseries. Do you place yourself on my back, O you of a blameless person.

sa: परदारावरोधस्य प्रसुप्तस्य निरीक्षणम्। इदं खलु ममात्यर्थं धर्मलोपं करिष्यति॥
en: Beholding a female, who is the religiously wedded wife of another, while she is asleep, verily cause loss of righteousness. *And therefore presumably incapable of taking care of herself.

sa: विद्राव्य शरवर्षेण वर्ष वायुरिवोत्थितम्। पाञ्चजन्यं महाशङ्ख प्रदध्मौ पुरुषोत्तमः॥
en: And dashing away (the Rākṣasa ranks) with his arrowy shower, even as the wind aroused dashes away a downpour, that best of male beings blew his mighty conch Pāñcajanya.

sa: प्रथमं वै महाराज कृत्यमेतदचिन्तितम्। केवलं वीर्यदर्पण नानुबन्धो विचारितः॥
en: At first, O mighty king, you did not ponder over this course of conduct; nor, from pride of prowess, did you at all take note of the evil thereof.

sa: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं विस्तरेण महाद्युते। यथा तुष्टो महादेवो देवराजस्तथानघ॥
en: All this, O you of brilliant lustre, I am desirous of hearing in detail. O pure one, how Mahadeva and the king of the gods were pleased (with you).

sa: प्राप्स्यसे च यदिष्टं तत् सांख्ययोगेप्सितं पदम्। एतावदुक्त्वा भगवानस्तमेवाभ्यवर्तत॥
en: You will also acquire that end which is desirable and which is coveted by both Sankhyas and Yogins. Having said so, the divine Sun proceeded to the setting hills.

sa: तस्यासौ दण्डविषयो विन्ध्यशैवलयोनृप॥ शप्तो ब्रह्मर्षिणा तेन वैधर्म्य सहिते कृते। ततः प्रभृति काकुत्स्थ दण्डकारण्यमुच्यते॥
en: O Rāma, in the golden age, the province between the mountains Vindhya and Saivala comprising Danda's territories, imprecated by the Brāhmaṇa saint, in consequence of the iniquity of the vicious souled, was reduced into a desert. From that time it passes by the name of Dandaka forest.

sa: ततो हलहलाशब्दो दिवस्पृगभवत् तदा। नानाविधानां भूतानां तत्कर्माणि प्रशंसताम्॥
en: Then a loud and confused noise arose, filling the sky and touching the very heavens, as it were, from various creatures who spoke highly of that feat of Dhananjaya.

sa: तेषां शब्दो महानासीद् द्रवतां वाहिनीमुखे। महौघस्येव जलधेर्गिरिमासाद्य दीर्यतः॥
en: The shouting noise made at the van by the retreating army was as furious as the grumbling roars of the breakers of the surging seas when dashing against rocks.

sa: मांसशोणितसंक्लेदां कुर्वन्भूमि स राक्षसः। चचार हरिसैन्येषु कालाग्निरिव मूर्च्छितः॥
en: And transported with passion, that Raksasa, making the earth miry with flesh and blood, spread among the monkey-ranks like to the fire at the time of the Universal dissolution.

sa: प्रायोपवेशिनो राजन् सर्वत्र सुखमुच्यते। गवाढ्यः शाकदीक्षायां स्वर्गगामी तृणाशनः॥
en: A man, O king, is said to acquire happiness, by abstention from food. By eating herbs alone, one gets cows. By living on grass, one acquires the celestial regions.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अस्मानभिातांस्तात भयार्ताञ्छरणैषिणः। कौरवान् विषमप्राप्तान् कथं ब्रूयास्त्वमीदृशम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O child, why do you speak these cruel words to these frightened Kurus who are now in adversity and who have come to us for protection?

sa: विनिःश्वसन् वै भृशदुर्मनास्ततः प्रमूढसंज्ञः परमापदं गतः। शमं न लेभे हृदयज्वरार्दितो नरर्षभो यूथहतो यथर्षभः॥
en: And sighing heavily with a heart oppressed with sorrow, well nigh deprived of consciousness, and involved in high peril, that best of men, oppressed by the fever of his heart, like to a mighty leader of a herd, separated from it, did not attain peace of mind.

sa: मृगाभिशापान्नष्टं मे जननं ह्यकृतात्मनः। नृशंसकारिणो भीरु यथैवोपहतं पुरा॥
en: O timid lady, as I was formerly addicted to cruel acts and led a vicious life, I have lost my power of procreation by the curse of the deer.

sa: भोजस्तु क्षतसर्वाङ्गो भीमसेनेन मारिष। रक्ताशोक इवोत्फुल्लो व्यभ्राजत रणाजिरे॥
en: Then, O sire, the ruler of the Bhojas wounded on all parts of his body, appeared on the field of battle like a red Ashoka tree covered with blossoms.

sa: वनमाली ततः क्षीबः कैलासशिखरोपमः। नीलवासा मदोसिक्त इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then proud and intoxicated with wine, Baladeva, who was like the Kailasa mountain, adorned with the garlands of wild flowers and attired in blue robes, thus spoke to all.

sa: अनेन प्रतिबोधेन प्रधानं प्रवदन्ति तत् सांख्ययोगाश्च तत्त्वज्ञा यथाश्रुतिनिदर्शनात्॥
en: In consequence of Individual Soul being reflected in Nature, the latter is called Pradhana by Sankhyas and Yogins conversant with the original principles as laid down in the Shrutis.

sa: असंतुष्टाश्च युताः स्थानान्मानात् प्रत्यवरोपिताः। स्वयं चोपहृता भृत्या ये चाप्युपहिताः परैः॥ परिक्षीणाश्च लुब्धाश्च क्रुद्धा भीताः प्रतारिताः। हतस्वा मानिनो ये च त्यक्तादाना महेप्सवः॥ संतापिताश्च ये केचिद् व्यसनौघप्रतीक्षिणः। अन्तर्हिता: सोपहितास्ते सर्वे परसाधनाः॥
en: Servants who are discontented, who have been dismissed from their offices, or who have been degraded from honourable situations, who have brought destitution upon themselves, or who have been ruined by their enemies, who have been weakened, who are rapacious, or enraged, or alarmed, or deceived, who have suffered confiscation, who are proud and willing to perform great feats but who are deprived of the means of acquiring wealth, and who burn with grief or anger for any injury done to them,-always wait for misfortunes to befall their masters. Being deceived, they forsake their masters and become powerful instruments in the hands of his enemies.

sa: मुनिर्यथारण्यगतो भाषसे धर्मसहितम्। न्यस्तदण्डो यथा पार्थं ब्राह्मणः संशितव्रतः॥
en: 'You are preaching the rules of morality, like a Muni living in the woods or like a Brahmana of austere observances who has cutoff all connections with this world.

sa: अजस्रं जन्मनिधनं चिन्तयित्वा त्रयीमिमाम्। परित्यज्य क्षयमिह अक्षयं धर्ममास्थितः॥
en: Thinking upon the incident of one's repeated births and deaths and avoiding the religion of acts which merely yield destructible results, one should follow the eternal religion of Yoga.

sa: त्याज्यं दोषवदित्येके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः। यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यमिति चापरे॥
en: Some wise men say that work itself should be abandoned considering it to be evil; others say that the works of sacrifice, gifts and penance should not be renounced.

sa: ततो रक्षः पिशाचाच श्वापदाश्चैव संघशः। जग्मुरायोधनं धोरं रुद्रस्याक्रीडासंनिभम्।॥
en: Thereafter large numbers of Rakshasas and Pisachas, as well as numerous other beasts, came to that dreadful field of battle, the looked like the sporting ground of Rudra himself.

sa: नानारूपधरैवीरैः पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन्। तस्य ज्ञातिर्हि विक्रान्तो ब्राह्मणादो बको हतः॥
en: Indeed surrounded by many heroic Rakshasas of diverse appearances, he came there recollecting the ancient quarrel with the Pandavas. His relative, the Brahmanadevouring Vaka had been slain (by Bhima).

sa: आदित्यो रजसा राजन् समवच्छन्नमण्डलः। विरश्मिरुदये नित्यं कबन्धैः समदृश्यत॥
en: The Sun's disc, O king, seemed to be always covered with dust. At its rise, the Sun was shorn of splendour and seemed to be crossed by headless trunks.

sa: तमब्रवीद् वामदेवस्तेजस्वी तपतां वरः। हेमवर्णं सुखासीनं ययातिमिव नाहुषम्॥
en: To him having a golden hue and seated at his ease like Yayati the son of Nahusha, that foremost of ascetics, viz., Vamadeva of great energy, said as follows.

sa: वञ्जयानौ पुनश्चैव चेरतुः कुरुसत्तमौ। विक्रीडन्तौ सुबलिनौ मण्डलानि विचेरतुः॥
en: Those two leading Kuru's heroes fared thus, each avoiding the other's attacks. Indeed, those two great warriors thus moved about in circles and seemed to play with each other.

sa: स्ततः समभ्येत्य नराधिपात्मजाम्। उवाच कृष्णामभिसान्त्वयंस्तदा मृगेन्द्रकन्यामिव जम्बुको वने॥
en: Having thus consulted Sudeshna Kichaka approached the daughter of the king (Draupadi) and addressed her in words of amity just as a jackal accosts a lioness in the forest.

sa: शिबिरौशीनरः प्राणान् प्रियस्य तनयस्य च। ब्राह्मणार्थमुपाकृत्य नाकपृष्ठमितो गतः॥
en: By offering the life of his dear son, for the behoof of a Brahmana king Shibi the son of Ushinara was taken from this world to the celestial regions

sa: ततः प्रवृत्तातिशुभा स्वरव्यञ्जनभूषिता। ओङ्कारमादितः कृत्वा मम देवी सरस्वती॥
en: Thought of by me, the auspicious Sarasvati appeared immediately before my eyes, adorned with all the vowels and the consonants and having placed the syllable OM in the van.

sa: अथारोहद्धृषीकेशः केतुः सर्वधनुष्मताम्। अर्जुनः सत्यकर्मा च कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: The Hrishikesha, that foremost of all bowmen, got upon that car. After him Arjuna of irresistible deeds and Yudhishthira the king of the Kurus, got upon the same car,

sa: ततः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैः कृतवर्मा शिलाशितैः। सात्यकि त्रिभिराहत्य धनुरेकेन चिच्छिदे॥
en: Then Kritavarman struck Satyaki with three arrows whetted on stone and shot off his bow drawn to its fullest stretch and then cut of his bow with another arrow.

sa: स त्वं क्षुद्रसमाचारो नीचात्मा पापनिश्चयः॥ आकेशाग्रान्नखाग्राच्च वक्तव्यो वक्तुमिच्छसि।
en: Ill-behaved, of low mind and sinful resolutions, you are condemnable from the end of your hair to the tip of your toe. Yet do you desire to censure others?

sa: स पालयामास महीं धर्मात्मा काशिनन्दनः। तैर्वीतहव्यैरागत्य युधि सर्वैर्विनिर्जितः॥
en: The delighter of Kashi, the righteous-souled prince ruled his kingdom for some time when the hundred sons of Vitihavya once more attacked his territories and defeated him in battle.

sa: कङ्कगोमायुगृध्राश्च चुक्रुशुर्भयशंसिनः। नित्याशिवकरा युद्धे शिवा घोरनिदर्शनाः॥ नेदुर्बलस्याभिमुखं ज्वालोद्गारिभिराननैः।
en: Kankas, Gomayas and vultures, portending fear, began to cry. Ever inauspicious in war, jackals presaging evil, with their mouths belching forth flame, howled in the face of the forces.

sa: उपेतुश्च विना रात्रिं ताराः खद्योतसप्रभाः। संलीनमीनविहगा नलिन्यः शुष्कपङ्कजाः॥
en: And when there was no night, stars wearing the sheen of fireflies, began to fall. And in the tanks fishes and fowls were inert, and the lotuses were withered.

sa: एतावदेतदाख्यानं सोत्तरं ब्रह्मपूजितम्। रामायणमिति ख्यातं मुख्यं वाल्मीकिना कृतम्।।१
en: This Story ends with the Uttară. It is held in reverence by Brahmå composed by Vālmīki and passes as the foremost of all under the name of the Ramayana.

sa: विचकर्ष धनुर्दिव्यं ततः कौरवनन्दनः। यन्त्रस्येवेह शब्दोऽभून्महांस्तस्य पुनः पुनः॥
en: The delighter of the Kurus then drew his celestial bow. And as he repeatedly stretched the bowstring, the twang that followed resembled the loud sound of some strong machine.

sa: मध्ये सेनामुखे कर्णोऽप्यवातिष्ठत दंशितः। चित्रवर्माङ्गदः स्त्रग्वी पालयन् वाहिनीमुखम्॥
en: In the centre, stood Karna at the head of the army, clad in armour and a beautiful coat of mail and adorned with bracelets and garlands, for protecting it.

sa: नृशंसं कर्म सुमहत् सर्वलोकविगर्हितम्। अस्वय॑मयशस्यं चाप्यधर्मिष्ठं च भारत॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, this act is yours is extremely cruel, it deserves universal excretion, it is infamous and sinful and will certainly lead (you) to hell.

sa: निःसंदिग्धं प्रबुद्धस्त्वं बुध्यमानश्चराचरम्। श्रोतुमिच्छामि तज्ज्ञानं घृतं मण्डमयं यथा॥
en: Forsooth, you are enlightened, fully conversant with the mobile and immobile universe. I wish to hear you describe that knowledge, which is compared to clarified butter having solid grains.

sa: व्यधमत् पाण्डवीं सेनामासुरीं मघवानिव। युधिष्ठिरं चाभ्यहनदपसव्यं चकार ह॥
en: Made a great havoc of the Pandava army like Indra killing the Asura army. Then wounding Yudhishthira with many arrows he placed the son of Pandu to his right.

sa: सर्वतः प्रतिविद्धस्तु तव पुत्रैर्महारथैः। तान् प्रत्यविध्यद्वाष्णैयः पृथक् पृथगजिह्मगैः॥
en: Thus opposed on all sides by your sons, all mighty car-warriors, he of the Vrishni race began to pierce them all in return with distinct groups of straight-going shafts.

sa: लोडयन्तमनीकानि द्विपं पद्मसरो यथा। नाशक्नुवन् वारयितुं पार्थं क्षत्रियपुङ्गवाः॥
en: Then the foremost Kshatriyas of your army were not able to oppose Pritha's son who had been agitating the troops like an elephant agitating a lake over-grown with lotuses.

sa: तमाश्रमं पुण्यसुखं शरण्यं सदैव शाखामृगसेवितान्तम्। महौजसौ राघवलक्ष्मणौ तौ॥
en: Espying the highly powerful Rāma and Lakş mana there, monkeys, terrified, entered into that holy and pleasant asylum, a worthy refuge and having its inside always frequented by them.

sa: अधर्मेणापकृष्टश्च मद्रराजः परेरितः॥ अधर्मेण तथा बाल: सौभद्रो विनिपातितः।
en: The king of the Madras was again weaned away from our side by an act of unrighteousness by the foe, unfairly also was the tender son of Subhadra slain.

sa: पूरितो वासुदेवेन शङ्खराट् स्वनते भृशम्। युध्यमानेषु वीरेषु सैन्धवस्याभिरक्षिषु॥
en: That prince of conchs viz., the Panchajanya, filled with the breath of Vasudeva's son, yielded loud blasts. When those heroes engaged in protecting the Sindhu ruler were thus fighting.

sa: शतघ्नीभिश्च चित्राभिर्बभौ भारत मेदिनी। कनकाङ्गदहारैश्च कुण्डलैर्मुकुटैस्तथा॥ वलयैरपविद्धैश्च तत्रैवाङ्गुलिवेष्टकैः। चूडामणिभिरुष्णीषैः स्वर्णसूत्रैश्च मारिष॥ तनुत्रैः सतलत्रैश्च हारैर्निष्कैश्च भारत। वस्त्रैश्छत्रैश्च विध्वस्तैश्चामरव्यजनैरपि॥ गजाश्वमनुजैभिन्नैः शोणिताक्तैश्च पत्रिभिः। तैस्तैश्च विविधौर्भिन्नस्तत्र तत्र वसुंधरा॥ पतितैरपविद्धैश्च विबभौ द्यौरिव ग्रहैः। अचिन्त्यमद्भुतं चैव तयोः कर्मातिमानुषम्॥ दृष्ट्वा चारणसिद्धानां विस्मयः समजायत। अग्नेर्वायुसहायस्य गतिः कक्ष इवाहवे॥ आसीद् भीमसहाय
en: And with beautiful Sataghnis, the earth looked, O Bharata beautiful, Strewn all over with ear-rings and neck-laces of gold and fallen-off bracelets and rings and precious gems worn on diadems and crowns and turbans and golden ornaments of diverse kinds and armours and leathern fences and elephantgirths and umbrellas dropped from their place and chamaras and fans; with the mangled bodies of elephants steeds and men; with arrows bathed in blood and with various other objects lying scattered about loosened from their places, the field of battle appeared beautiful like the sky bespangled with the planets. Beholding their inconceivable, wonderful and super-human feats, the Siddha and the Charanas were filled with surprise. The son of Adhiratha engaged with Bhima coursed on the field in the same

sa: अथाभिजग्मुर्मुनिमाश्रमस्थं तपस्विनधर्मभृतां वरिष्ठम्। अगस्त्यमत्यद्भुतवीर्यवन्तं तं चार्थमूचुः सहिताः सुरास्ते॥
en: Then the assembled celestials all went to the Rishi living in his hermitage, that ascetic, that foremost of virtuous men, the wonderfully powerful Agastya; and they told him all.

sa: दह्यमाना मनोदुःखैर्व्याधिभिश्चातुरा नराः। ह्लादन्ते स्वेषु दारेषु धर्मार्ताः सलिलेष्विव॥
en: Men, burnt out by mental grief or afflicted by disease, feel as much relieved in the company of their wives as a perspiring man does in a cool bath.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज पाण्डवेन यशस्विना। सृक्किणी लेलिहन् वीरः क्रोधरक्तान्तलोचनः॥
en: Thus deeply pierced, O king, by the highsouled son of Pandu, the heroic Karna began to lick the corners of his mouth and his eyes became red in rage.

sa: सर्वेष्वपि च योधेषु चिन्तयशिनिपुङ्गव। त्वत्तः सुहृत्तमं कञ्चिन्नाभिजानामि सात्यके॥
en: O foremost of the Sinis, thinking within inyself, I cannot find out any one, among all my troops, who is a greater well-wisher of ours than yourself, O Satyaki.

sa: पितामहपुरोगाश्च सर्वे देवगणास्तथा। ऋषयश्च महाभागास्तद् युद्धं द्रष्टुमागमन्॥ विमानागौमहाराज सिद्धाश्च भरतर्षभ। गन्धर्वाश्च विमानागौरप्सरोभिः समागमन॥
en: All the deities led by the Grand-father, and all the highly-blessed Rishis, came to see the battle, on their best of cars; and the Siddhas, also, O foremost of Bharata's family, and the Gandharvas, with the Apsaras, on their own beautiful and foremost of cars, came there.

sa: ते वयं पाण्डवज्येष्ठं तरुण वृद्धशीलिनम्। अभिषिञ्चाम् साध्वद्य सत्यकारुण्यवेदिनम्॥
en: We shall therefore with all proper ceremonies, in all the eldest eldest Pandava (Yudhisthira) endued with youth, accomplished in battle, versed in the Vedas and is truthful and kind.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाराज द्रोणपुत्रः प्रतापवान्। एकान्ते योजयित्वाश्वान् प्रायादभिमुखः परान्॥
en: Sanjaya continued “Having said so, O king, the brave son of Drona yoked his horses to his car at a corner and started towards the direction of his enemies.

sa: ते चेदक्षत्रियाः सन्तो विरुध्येरन् कथंचन। सर्वोपायैर्नियन्तव्या विकर्मस्था नराधिप॥
en: If, without being born Kshatriyas they show sings of hostility, they should then, because they follow practices not sanctioned for them be tried to be restrained by every means.

sa: यच्च ते द्रोणभीष्माभ्यां युद्धमासीदरिन्दम। मनसैकेन योद्धव्यं तत्ते युद्धमुपस्थितम्॥
en: A dreadful battle, O chastiser of foes, like that which you have fought with Bhishma and Drona is now before you, to be fought, (however) with your mind alone.

sa: ततः स पुरुषव्याघ्रः कुलीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ उवाच मातरं वीरो निःश्वसन्निव पन्नगः। यः शरोमिर्ध्वजावर्तो महाभुजमहाग्रहः॥ तलशब्दानुनदितो महारथमहाह्रदः। यस्येषुपातमासाद्य नान्यस्तिष्ठेद् धनंजयात्॥ कथं पुत्रो भवत्याः स देवगर्भः पुराभवत्।
en: Then that foremost of men, viz., the heroic Yudhishthira, sighing like a snake asked his mother,-'Were you the mother of that Karna who was like a sea having arrows for his billows, his tall standard for his vortex, his own mighty arms for a couple of huge alligators, his large car for his deep lake, and the sound of his palms or his tempestuous roar, and whose force none could withstand except Dlananjaya? How was that son resembling a very god born of you in former days?

sa: स तस्य ह्रदयं भित्त्वा प्रविवेशातिवेगितः। शक्राशनिरिवोत्सृष्टो विदार्य धरणीतलम्॥
en: Endued with great force, that shaft struck the heart of Suratha and coming out entered the Earth riving her through like the thunder-bolt of Indra hurled from the sky.

sa: प्रतापकालमधिकं यदा मन्येत चात्मनः। तदा लिप्सेत मेधावी परभूमिधनान्युत॥
en: When the king thinks that his power is greater than that of an enemy, he should then, helped by his intelligence, seek to acquire the latter's territories and wealth.

sa: यदि तच्छक्यमस्माभिर्जातुं धर्मभृतां वर। श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत् सर्वं यथैतदुपलभ्यते॥
en: If the subject be not far from our comprehension, O foremost of virtuous men, I wish to hear everything about the way in which virtuous conduct can be acquired.

sa: बलेन तेन विक्रम्य वर्तमाने जनक्षये। पृष्ठतः पाण्डवानीकमभ्यघ्ननिशितैः शरैः॥
en: During the onset of that great carnage, Shakuni, aided by the force, displayed his valor and assailed the Pandava army at the rear, killing it with his keen arrows.

sa: शक्त्यस्त्रं भगवान् भीमं पुनः पुनरवाकिरत्। आदधचात्मनस्तेजो हविषेद्ध इवानलः॥
en: He repeatedly hurled his terrible weapon, viz., the dart, he had received from Agni. The energy displayed by him then resembled a fire fed with libations of clarified butter.

sa: समन्तात् कीर्यमाणस्तु बाणसंधैर्महात्मभिः॥ न चचाल महाराज सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः।
en: Though struck thus from all sides with numerous arrows by those illustrious warriors, Duryodhana still, O king, did not waver, in the presence of all the soldiers assembled there.

sa: महर्षिभिर्यक्षमहोरगैरपि। जयाभिवृद्ध्या परयाभिपूजितौ हते तु कर्णे परमाहवे तदा॥
en: After Karna had been killed in that dreadful encounter, the celestials, Gandharvas, men, Charanas, Rishis, Yakshas and Nagas respectfully offered adorations of Krishna and Arjuna and wished them success.

sa: ये वदन्तीह सत्यानि प्राणत्यागेऽप्युपस्थिते। प्रमाणभूता भूतानां दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते॥
en: Those, who always speak truth in this world even when life is in danger, and who are models for all creatures to follow, succeed in getting over all difficulties.

sa: योऽसौ युगसहस्रान्ते प्रदीप्तार्चिविभावसुः। सम्भक्षयति भूतानि तस्मै घोरात्मने नमः॥
en: At the end of a thousand cycles, you assume the form of a fire with blazing flames and consume all creatures. Salutations to you in your form of fierceness.

sa: मूलमेवादितश्छिन्द्यात् परपक्षस्य पण्डितः। ततः सहायान् पक्षं च मूलमेवानुसाधयेत्॥
en: A wise king should cut off the very roots of his enemy. He should then win over and bring under his control the allies and partisans of that enemy.

sa: ब्राह्मणास्त्वां महाबाहो भ्रातरच महौजसः। पर्जन्यमिव घर्मान्ते नाथमाना उपासते॥
en: The Brahmanas, O mighty-armed one, and these your highly energetic brothers stand before you beseechingly like persons soliciting Indra the gods of the clouds at the close of summer.

sa: एष तप्त्वा रणे शत्रूशस्त्रतापेन वीर्यवान्। नरसूर्योऽस्तमभ्येति सूर्योऽस्तमिव केशव॥
en: Having scorched his enemies with the fire of his weapons in battle, that brave warrior, that Sun among men, O Keshava, has set like the real Sun at evening.

sa: सोऽब्रवीजाजसंरम्भस्तथा लोकगुरुर्गुरुम्। प्रजाः सृष्टाः परेणेमाः किं करिष्याम्यनेन वै॥
en: Thus accosted, that lord of the universe angrily answered the lord Brahman,Somebody else has created all these creatures. What purpose then would be fulfilled by this organ of mine.

sa: स वै किरीटं बहुरत्नभूषितं जहार नागोऽर्जुन मूर्धतो बलात्। गिरेः सुजाताङ्करपुष्तिदुमं महेन्द्रवज्रः शिखरोत्तमं यथा॥
en: O monarch, the snake, by its own prowess, snatched from Partha's head that beautiful ornament of good shape set with precious stones and diamonds, very brilliant to look at and crushed it to pieces as the thunder breaks down mountain tops adorned with fine trees and flowers.

sa: दृढमूलस्त्वदुष्टात्मा विदित्वा बलमात्मनः। अबलानभियुञ्जीत न तु ये बलवत्तराः॥
en: A king, whose power has been consolidated and who is confident of his own strength, should attack a neighbour who is weaker than himself but never who is stronger.

sa: ख्यातः सुवर्णष्ठीवीति पुत्रस्तव भविष्यति। रक्ष्यश्च देवराजात् स देवराजसमद्युतिः॥
en: Your son shall be known by the name of Suvarnashthivin. He shall be effulgent like the king of gods, but take care to protect him always from that deity.

sa: अभीरूणामिमे लोका भास्वन्तो हन्त पश्यत। पूर्णा गन्धर्वकन्याभिः सर्वकामदुहोऽक्षयाः॥
en: He addressed them, saying-Look, these are the effulgent regions, reserved for those who fight fearlessly! Abounding with Gandharva girls, those regions are eternal and capable of granting every desire.

sa: अपि चोद्धर्षणं कार्य भीरूणामपि यलतः। स्कन्धदर्शनमात्रात्तु तिष्ठेयुर्वा समीपतः॥
en: The fear-stricken should, with care, be comforted and encouraged. These weaker combatants should be placed on the field only to show the number of the army to the foe.

sa: भिक्षुकांश्चाक्रिकांश्चैव क्लीवोन्मत्तान् कुशीलवान्। बाह्यान् कुर्यान्नरश्रेष्ठ दोषाय स्युर्हि तेऽन्यथा॥
en: During such times, all beggars, cartmen, eunuchs, lunatics, should, O foremost of men, be driven out of the town, for if they are allowed to remain, evil will come.

sa: ताभिः परिवृतो राजा क्रोशन्तीभिः सहस्रशः। ऊर्ध्वबाहुभिरार्ताभी रुदतीभिः प्रियाप्रियैः॥
en: The king was soon surrounded by those thousands of ladies who with arms raised up in grief, were bewailing aloud and uttering all sorts of words, agreeable and disagreeable.

sa: वेतसो वेगमायातं दृष्ट्वा नमति नापरे। सरिद्वेगेऽव्यतिक्रान्ते स्थानमासाद्य तिष्ठति॥
en: The cane, seeing the advancing current, bends to it. The others do not act in this way. After the current has passed away, the cane resumes its pristine posture.

sa: हृतराज्यो हतबन्धुर्हतचक्षुश्च वै तथा। न भ्राजिष्ये महाप्राज्ञ क्षीणरश्मिरिवांशुमान्॥
en: Deprived of kingdom, deprived of relatives, and shorn of eyes, I cannot, O you of great wisdom, shine any longer on Earth like a luminary divested of its splendour.

sa: आधुन्वन्तो गदे घोरे चन्दनागरुरूषिते। वैरस्यान्तं परीप्सन्तौ रणे क्रुद्धाविवान्तकौ॥
en: Whirling their terrible maces which were smeared with sandal-paste and other unguents, the two heroes, desirous of terminating their hostilities, moved about in that battle like two angry Yamas.

sa: अस्मिन् खलु महाभागे शुभे तीर्थवरेऽनघे॥ त्यक्त्वा सप्तर्षयो जग्मुहिमवन्तमरुन्धतीम्।
en: In this very Tirtha, O auspicious, sinless and highly blessed one, the seven Rishis had once left Arundhati (the wife of one of them) while they went to Himavat.

sa: तस्य बाणसहस्रैस्तु प्रच्छन्ना ह्यभवन्मही। परांश्च सिषिचे बाणैर्धाराभिरिव पर्वतान्॥
en: With the thousands of arrows shot by him, the Earth was completely covered. He drenched his enemies with showers of arrows like the clouds pouring rain on mountain breasts.

sa: एवं संसारचक्रेऽस्मिन् व्याविद्धे रथचक्रवत्। समेति भूतग्रामोऽयं भूतग्रामेण कार्यवान्॥
en: Thus, endued with actions, creatures come into this wheel of life that is continually turning like the wheel of a car, and coming there, they meet with their fellow-creatures.

sa: द्रोणभीष्मार्णवं ती। कर्णपातालसम्भवम्। मा निमजस्व सगणः शल्यमासाद्य गोष्पदम्॥
en: Having crossed the fathomless represented by Bhishma and Drona and Karna, do not sink, with your followers, in a pit dug by a cow's hoop represented by Shalya. ocean

sa: दृष्ट्वा तयोस्तं युधि सम्प्रहारं परस्परस्यान्तरमीक्षमाणयोः। र्योधाः सर्वे विस्मयमभ्यगच्छन्॥
en: The other warriors were struck with wonder in seeing that fearful combat between those great warriors who were always trying to take advantage of each other's failings (weak points).

sa: तस्मादद्यैव गन्तव्यं युद्ध्यस्व भरतर्षभ। परमव्यक्तरूपस्य व्यक्तं त्यक्त्वा स्वकर्मभिः॥
en: Therefore, fight that battle this every day, O foremost of Bharata's race, not caring for your body, and helped by your own acts, conquer the enemy of your mind,

sa: यथोक्तवादिनं दूतं क्षत्रधर्मरतो नृपः। यो हन्यात् पितरस्तस्य भ्रूणहत्यामवाप्नुयुः॥
en: That king, mindful of Kshatriya practices, who kills a messenger faithfully speaking out his message, causes his departed manes to be stained with the sin of killing a foetus.

sa: तत्र भूतं महाकायं चन्द्रार्कसदृशद्युतिम्। सोऽपश्यद् द्वारमाश्रित्य तिष्ठन्तं लोमहर्षणम्॥
en: He there saw a being of huge frame capable of making the very hair erect and endued with the effulgence of the Sun or the Moon, guarding the entrance.

sa: अश्वत्थाम्नः श्रुतं कर्म शापश्चान्योन्यकारितः। वृत्तान्तमुत्तरं ब्रूहि यदभाषत संजयः॥
en: I have heard of the wonderful deeds of Ashvatthaman and the exchange of curses. Tell me what took place next, and what Sanjaya next said to the old king."

sa: यातु कश्चित्तु पाञ्चाल्यं क्षिप्रमागम्यतामिति। परिश्रान्तबलस्तात नैष मुच्येत किल्विषी॥
en: Let somebody go to the Panchala prince and ask him to come here. The Kaurava troops are all exhausted. O sire, the sinful Duryodhana will never succeed in escaping.

sa: यामः सर्वे च सम्भूय सवाजिरथकुञ्जराः॥ परित्रातुं महेष्वासान् मद्रराजपदानुगान्।
en: We shall, therefore, all of us, in a body with our cars and horses and elephants, proceed, for rescuing those great bowmen, viz., the followers of the Madra king.

sa: भीष्म उवाच शृणु राजन्नवहितो बहुकारणविस्तरम्। जातरूपसमुत्पत्तिमनुभूतं च यन्मया।॥
en: Bhishma said Listen, O king, with rapt attention to me as I recite to you in detail the circumstances connected with the origin of gold as understood by me.

sa: स तं निवृत्तमालक्ष्य प्राञ्जलि: पृष्ठतोऽन्वगात्। आविक्षितो महीपालः संवर्तमुपशिक्षितुम्॥
en: And on seeing him turn back, that prince, the son of Avikshit followed his footsteps with his hands joined together, and with a view to receive instruction from him.

sa: आचक्ष्व मेऽद्य संग्रामं यथापूर्वमरिंदम। कस्मादेवं विलपतीं नाघेह प्रतिभाषसे॥
en: Do you tell me the incidents of battle today as before, O chastiser of enemies. Oh, why do you not answer me today, me who am weeping so bitterly?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच द्विवर्षोपनिवृत्तेषु पाण्डवेषु यदृच्छया। देवर्षिर्नारदो राजन्नाजगाम युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: After two years had passed from the date of the return of the Pandavas from the retreat of heir sire), the celestial Rishi, Narada, O king, came to Yudhishthria.

sa: विपिधस्य महाराज विपरीतं विवर्जयेः। चारैर्विदित्वा शुज्रेश्च ये राज्ञामन्तरैषिणः॥
en: Learning through your spies who your enemies are, who are bent on finding out your shortcoming, you should, through trusted agents, cause them to be destroyed from a distance.

sa: मानसं सर्वभूतानां धर्ममाहुर्मनीषिणः। तस्मात् सर्वाणि भूतानि धर्ममेव समासते॥
en: The wise have said that the mind of every creature is the true test of virtue Hence, all creatures in this world have an innate tendency to achieve virtue.

sa: इत्येषा पुरुषश्रेष्ठ श्राद्धोत्पत्तिर्यथागमम्। व्याख्याता पूर्वनिर्दिष्टा दानं वक्ष्याम्यतः परम्॥
en: I have thus, O prince of Kuru's explained to you, according to the scriptures, the ordinances relating to Shraddhas. I shall one more discourse to you on gifts. race

sa: सुवर्णशृङ्गैस्तु विराजितानां गवां सहस्रस्य नरः प्रदानात्। मित्येवमाहुर्दिवि देवसंघाः॥
en: The man who gives away a thousand kine with horns bedecked with gold, succeeds in acquiring Heaven. This has been declared by the very deities in a celestial assemblage.

sa: भैक्ष्येणान्नं समाहृत्य विप्रो वेदपुरस्कृतः। स्वाध्यायनिरते विप्रे दत्त्वेह सुखमेधते॥
en: A Brahmana knowing the Vedas, by giving away food acquired by him as alms, to a Brahmana devoted to the study of the Vedas, succeeds in acquiring happiness here.

sa: विदुरः संजयश्चैव राज्ञः शय्यां कुशैस्ततः॥ चक्रतुः कुरुवीरस्य गान्धार्याश्चाविदूरतः।
en: Then Vidura and Sanjaya made a bed for the king by spreading some blades of Kusha grass. Near the bed of that Kuru hero they made another for Gandhari.

sa: समाधेयास्त्वया राजंस्त्वय्यद्य कुलधूर्गता। श्रश्रूश्वशुरयोः पादान् शुश्रूषन्ती वने त्वहम्॥
en: I shall live in the forest with Gandhari, besmearing my body with fifth, engaged in the practice of penances, and devoted to the service of my father-in-law and mother-in-law.

sa: एष ते भरतश्रेष्ठ यज्ञानां विधिरुत्तमः॥ याख्यातो ह्यानुपूर्वेण उपवासफलात्मकः।
en: I have thus told you, O chief of the Bharatas, what the excellent ordinances are as son about sacrifices, one ' after another, dependent upon the fruits of fasts.

sa: तत्र चित्राङ्गदो नाम बलवानरिमर्दनः। तेन युद्धमभूत् तस्य विजयस्यातिभैरवम्॥
en: The ruler of that people was Chitrangada who was gifted with great strength and was a crusher of enemies. Between him and Vijaya took place a very dreadful battle.

sa: तस्य भूतपतेः स्थानं भीमरूपधरं बभौ॥ अप्रधृष्यतरं चैव महोरगसमाकुलम्।
en: The retreat of that lord of all creatures, filled with many terrible forms, shone with a peculiar beauty. Abounding with many large snakes, it was unapproachable and unbearable. ।

sa: समासाद्य तु राजानं वार्ष्णेयकुरुपुङ्गवौ। निषीदतुरनुज्ञातौ प्रीयमाणेन तेन तौ॥
en: Meeting the king, he of Vrishni's race, as also that foremost hero of Kuru's race, getting the permission of Yudhishthira who was highly pleased with them, sat themselves down.

sa: तथा ब्रह्मसरो गत्वा धर्मारण्योपशोभितम्। पुण्डरीकमवाप्नोति उपस्पृश्य नरः शुचिः॥
en: One who goes to Brahmasara which is adorned by the woods called Dharmaranya one becomes purged of all one's sins in and acquires the merit of the Pundarika sacrifice.

sa: नित्यं द्वन्द्वसमायुक्तं सत्त्वमाहुर्मनीषिणः। निर्द्वन्द्वो निष्कलो नित्यः क्षेत्रज्ञो निर्गुणात्मकः॥
en: An object of enjoyment as it is, Nature is unintelligent and knows nothing. He, however, who enjoys it, is said to know it, Soul being enjoyer, Nature is enjoyed.

sa: शरस्तम्बे कुशस्तम्बे द्रोणशर्मपदे तथा। अपां प्रपतनासेवी सेव्यते सोऽप्सरोगणैः॥
en: Bathing in the waterfalls at Sharastamva and Kushustamva and Dronasharmapada, one is sure to acquire the region of the Apsaras where one is dutifully served by those superhuman beings.

sa: क्षतक्षीणाभितप्तानां ग्राम्यधर्मरतात्मनाम्। अध्वना कर्शितानां च न मांसाद्विद्यते परम्॥
en: There is nothing that is more beneficial than meat to persons who are lean or weak, or afflicted with disease or addicted to sexual union or exhausted with travel.

sa: एवमुक्तः स तैर्विप्रैर्भगवाँलोकभावनः। तेभ्यः शशंस धर्मात्मा याथातथ्येन बुद्धिमान्॥
en: Thus addressed by those learned Brahmanas, the illustrious creator of the worlds, endued with great intelligence and possessed of a righteous soul, described to them accurately what they asked.

sa: गङ्गाह्रद उपस्पृश्य तथा चैवोत्पलावने। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति तत्र मासं कृतोदकः॥
en: Bathing in Gangahrada and the tirtha Utplavana and daily offering oblations of water there for a full month to the departed manes, one acquires the merit of a Horse-sacrifice.

sa: एष वै समवायश्च ऋषिदेवसमन्वितः॥ आद्यः प्रकीर्तितो राजन् सर्वपापप्रमोचनः।
en: They are primeval Rishis, O king, whose names, if taken, are capable of purifying one of every sin. After this I shall recite the names of the principle kings.

sa: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच श्रेयांसं मार्गमन्विच्छन् सदा यः पृच्छति द्विजान्। धर्मान्वेषी गुणाकाङ्गी स स्वर्गे समुपाश्नुते॥
en: Maheshvara said That man who is desirous of determing what is righteousness, and who wishes to acquire prominent virtues and qualities, and who always puts questions to the Brahmanas with a view to find out the path leading to his highest good, succeeds in ascending to Heaven.

sa: सर्वदा पार्थिवेनेह सततं भूतिमिच्छता। भूर्देया विधिवच्छक पात्रे सुखमभीप्सुना॥
en: That king, O Shakra, who wishes to have prosperity and who wishes to acquire happiness for himself, should always make gifts of earth, with due rites, to worthy persons.

sa: हेतूनामन्तमासाद्य विपुलं ज्ञानमुत्तमम्॥ ज्योतिः सर्वस्य लोकस्य विपुलं प्रतिपद्यते।
en: When one gets to the very end of reasons, he attains to that excellent and all comprehending knowledge—that vast mass of effulgence, which illumines all the universe (called Brahma).

sa: आत्मानमाख्याति हि कर्मभिर्नरः सुशीलचारित्रकुलैः शुभाशुभैः। प्रणष्टमप्याशु कुलं तथा नरः पुनः प्रकाशं कुरुते स्वकर्मतः॥
en: A person proclaims himself by his own good and bad deeds and by his good or bad nature and race of birth. If ones' race of birth happens to be degraded for any reason, one soon raises it and makes it resplendent and famous by his deeds.

sa: प्रियो मेऽयं प्रियोऽस्याहमिति सम्प्रेक्ष्य बुद्धिमान्। वयस्यामैवमक्लिष्टं दानं दद्यादतन्द्रितः॥
en: This one is dear to me. I also am dear to him. Actuated by considerations like these, an intelligent person, freely and with alacrity, makes gifts to a friend.

sa: यन्मयोक्तमिदं वाक्यं युष्माभिश्चाप्युपश्रुतम्। सक्तुप्रस्थेन वो नायं यज्ञस्तुल्यो द्विजर्षभाः॥
en: You have all heard what I have said. You foremost of twice-born persons, this sacrifice is not equal in merit to the gift of a prastha of powdered barley.

sa: हयश्च हयमेधार्थं स्वयं स ब्रह्मवादिना। उत्सृष्टः शास्त्रविधिना व्यासेनामिततेजसा॥
en: The horse that was brought for the HorseSacrifice was let loose, according to the injunctions of the scriptures, by that utterer of Brahma, viz., Vyasa himself of great energy.

sa: दारेष्वधीनो धर्मश्च पितॄणामात्मनस्तथा। न वेत्ति कर्मतो भार्यारक्षणे योऽक्षमः पुमान्॥ अयशो महदाप्नोति नरकांश्चैव गच्छति।
en: The wife should know her husband by his deeds. Indeed, that man who fails to protect his wife, carns great infamy here and goes into Hell hereafter. Such a man falls down from even a position of great fame and never succeeds in acquiring happy regions hereafter.

sa: एवं कृत्वा नमस्तस्मै महादेवाय रंहसे। महात्मने क्षितिपते तत्सुवर्णमवाप्स्यसि॥
en: There bowing to that deity, you must seck his protection. And thus, O prince, making your submission to that great Mahadeva of great energy, you will acquire that gold.

sa: हृदयैः शून्यभूतैस्ते धृतराष्ट्रप्रवासजम्। दुःखं संधारयन्तो हि नष्टसंज्ञा इवाभवन्॥
en: Bearing in their hearts, from which every other thoughts had been removed, the sorrow born of Dhritarashtra's desire to leave the world, they looked like men shorn of consciousness.

sa: सोऽहमिच्छामि भवता सर्वस्वेनापि याजितुम्। कामये समतिक्रान्तुं वासवं त्वत्कृतैर्गुणैः॥
en: And thus repulsed, I now wish to spend all I possess, to have this sacrifice performed by you, and to outstrip Vasava by the merit of your good offices.

sa: पापं कर्म च यत् किंचिद् ब्रह्महत्यासमं भवेत्। शोधयेत् कपिला ह्येका प्रदत्तं गोशतं यथा॥
en: The gift of a single Kapila cow is capable cleansing whatever sins the giver may be guilty of even if those sins be as grave as Brahmanicide, for the gift of a single Kapila cow is considered as equal in merit to that of a hundred kine.

sa: देवतातिथिपूर्वं च सदा प्राश्नीत वाग्यतः। अस्पर्धितमनाश्चैव लघ्वाशी देवताश्रयः॥
en: Controlling speech the while, he should eat after satisfying celestials and guests. His mind should be shorn of envy. He should eat little, and depend always on the celestials.

sa: तथैवाश्वयुजं मासमेकभक्तेन यः क्षिपेत्। मृजावन् वाहनाढ्यश्च बहुपुत्रश्च जायते॥
en: The man who passes the month of Ashvin, taking himself one meal a day, becomes pure in soul and body, possessed of many animals and vehicles and large progeny.

sa: स्वदारनिरतो नित्यं शिष्टाचारो जितेन्द्रियः। पञ्चभिश्च महायज्ञैः श्रद्दधानो यजेदिह॥
en: Always devoted to his married wife, acting like a good man, with his senses under control, and full of faith, one should in this world perform the five sacrifice.

sa: आत्ममांसप्रदानेन शिबिरौशीनरो नृपः।।१०० प्राप्य पुण्यकुताल्लोकान् मोदते दिवि सुव्रतः।
en: Ushinara's son Shibi of excellent vows, by giving away the flesh of his own body, is rejoicing in the celestial region, having attained to the regions of the pious.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्येतद् गोषु मे प्रोक्तं माहात्म्यं भरतर्षभ। गुणैकदेशवचनं शक्यं पारायणं न तु॥
en: Bhishma said This is what I say to you on the subject of the glory and superiority of kine, O chief of Bharata's race. I am competent to describe a part only of the merits of the kine. I have not the ability to exhaust the subject.

sa: संन्यासी ज्ञानसंयुक्तः प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम्। अतीतो द्वन्द्वमभ्येति तमोमृत्युजरातिगः॥
en: The man who follows renunciation and who is endued with knowledge, who is above all pairs of opposites, as also darkness, death, and decrepitude, attains to the highest goal.

sa: प्रकाश्यं सत्त्वमादित्यः संतापो रजसो गुणः। उपप्लवस्तु विज्ञेयस्तामसस्तस्य पर्वसु॥
en: Thic Sun representing light is Goodness; the heat is the quality of Darkness; the shading (or eclipse) of the Sun on Parvan days, should be known to represent Ignorance.

sa: स्त्रियः कौरवनाथस्य भीष्मं कुरुकुलोद्वहम्॥ तालवृन्तान्युपादाय पर्यवीजन्त सर्वशः। ततोऽस्य विधिवच्चक्रुः पितृमेधं महात्मनः॥ यजनं बहुशश्चाग्नौ जगुः सामानि सामगाः।
en: Yudhishthira and Dhritarashtra stood at the feet of the body, taking up palmyra fans, the wives of the lord of the Kurus stood around the body and began to fan it softly. The Pitri sacrifice of the great Bhishma was then duly performed. Many libations were poured upon the sacred fire. The singers of Samans sang many Samans.

sa: गौतम उवाच प्रजापत्याः सन्ति लोका महान्तो नाकस्य पृष्ठे पुष्कला वीतशोकाः। मनीषिताः सर्वलोकोद्भवानां तत्र त्वाहं हस्तिनं यातयिष्ये।॥
en: Gautama said Above the firmament are the regions of the Prajapatis, of superior happiness, abounding in every happiness, and shorn of sorrow. Belonging to those powerful ones from whom the creation has originated, they are coveted by all persons. If you go there, even their shall I go and compel you to yield up this elephant to me.

sa: क्षुत्पिपासाश्रमाविष्टो मुनिरुद्दालकिस्तदा। यमं पश्येति तं पुत्रमशपत् स महातपाः॥
en: Stricken as he then was by hunger, thirst, and fatigue, the Rishi Uddalaki of great ascetic merit, in a sudden anger cursed his son, saying, meet with Yama today.

sa: यज्ञं बहुसुवर्णं वा वासवप्रियमाचरेत्॥ सत्यवान् दानशीलश्च ब्रह्मण्यश्चानसूयकः। क्षान्तो दान्तो जितक्रोधः स गच्छति परां गतिम्॥ पाण्डुराभ्रप्रतीकाशे विमाने हंसलक्षणे। द्वे समाप्ते ततः पद्मे सोऽप्सरोभिर्वसेत् सह॥ द्वितीये दिवसे यस्तु प्राश्नीयादेकभोजनम्। सदा द्वादशमासांस्तु जुह्वानो जातवेदसम्॥ अग्निकार्यपरो नित्यं नित्यं कल्यप्रबोधनः। अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः॥
en: Such a man is considered as having performed a Sacrifice, with plenty of gifts in gold, that is dear to Vasava himself. By practising truthfulness of speech, making gifts, respecting the Brahmanas, avoiding malice, becoming forgiving and self controlled and conquering anger, a man acquires the highest end. Riding on a car of the colour of white clouds that is drawn by swans, he lives, for millions and millions of years, in the company of Apsaras. Fasting for a whole day and taking only one meal on the second day, he who pours libations upon his sacred fire for the period of a whole year, indeed, he who observes such a fast and attends every day to his fire and rises every day from bed before sunrise, acquires the merit of the Agnishtoma sacrifice. Such a man acquires a car drawn by swans a

sa: एवमेतादृशं मोक्षं सुसूक्ष्मं ब्राह्मणा विदुः। विदित्वा चानुतिष्ठन्ति क्षेत्रज्ञेनार्थदर्शिना॥
en: The Brahmanas understand Liberation, which is exceedingly subtle, to be of this kind; and having understood it, they live accordingly, directed by the Kshetrajna, that seer of all topics.

sa: अहिंसा सर्वभूतानां नित्यमस्मासु रोचते। प्रत्यक्षतः साधयामो न परोक्षमुपास्महे॥
en: Always abstaining from cruelty to all creatures is what is lauded. We establish this from what is directly perceptible. We do not rely on what is beyond direct perception.

sa: छागमग्निर्गुणापेतमिला पुष्पफलं बहु। सुधन्वा शकटं चैव रथं चामितकूबरम्॥
en: Agni gave him a goat having many good qualities. Ila gave him profuse flowers and fruits. Sudhanvan gave him a riding chariot and a car of the great Kubera.

sa: तत्र दिव्यानभिप्रायान् ददर्श कुशिकस्तदा। पर्वतान् रूप्यसानूंश्च नलिनीश्च सपङ्कजाः॥ चित्रशालाश्च विविधास्तोरणानि च भारत। शाद्वलोपचितां भूमिं तथा काञ्चनकुट्टिमाम्॥
en: Kushika saw in every part of that building signs of celestial design. And he saw hills with charming valleys, and lakes with lotuses on their bosom; and mansions full of rich and curious articles, and gateways and arches, O Bharata, and the king beheld many open glades and open spots carpeted with grass, and resembling fields of gold.

sa: एकं शास्तारमासाद्य शब्देनैकेन संस्कृताः। नाना व्यवसिताः सर्वे सर्पदेवर्पिदानवाः॥
en: Having gone to one tcacher, and having been instructed (refined) by one word, the snakes, the celestials, the Rishis, and the Danavas, all betook themselves to various different dispositions.
